steps.name: Decide the live pool bound and import path

steps.name: Build episode_view on rebuild_context
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. Layer 0 acceptance holds on synthetic fixtures: as-of withholding, the three-question cut, the inferred mark; the 50-target export is a synthetic test fixture

steps.name: Add principle, evidence and arm-forecast tables
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. One idempotent alembic revision creates preference_principles, preference_evidence and the arm-forecast table; it applies twice without error and refuses a second row for the same notification and arm

steps.name: Add the review-card marker and no-forecast switch
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. Open sub-question 8 is closed; answering a marked review card yields one ruling row, zero extractor-input rows, no forecast row, zero PredictionDecision case rows, and answer_source_of does not label it human

steps.name: Build the extractor job
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. Open sub-question 5 is closed (job class, model door); the eight extractor-rule checks, idempotent replay through the query_fn seam and the model-door probe pass; the probe reads 'not run, blocked by open sub-question 5' until it has run

steps.name: Build principle status and retrieval
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. Status is derived as of an ask from evidence with both answered_at and extracted_at at or before it, and from review_card ruling rows across extractor versions; retrieval fetches all of the owner's principles below the 500 bound, filters status after the vector search and keeps k (5); an encoder_version change re-embeds; the prompt-block builder exists; the acceptances 'Contested outrank applicable', 'No future principle', 'Ruling is as-of', 'Ruling survives a version switch' and the collision test pass

steps.name: Send the capped review card
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. A split step looks for a card feature separating two sets of supporting episodes; an unseparable pair is marked contested and a batched multiple-choice card goes out through the present_choices caller; at most 3 cards per owner in any rolling 24 hours, tested with a fixed clock; answering it writes one ruling row and clears 'contested'

steps.name: Plug arms into replay_loop.replay
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. replay is extended to hand an arm its episode_view and as-of principles and summarize pairs arms through a run whose engine records are the arm's; no second harness exists

steps.name: Replay the 50-target fixture in time order
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. Replay runs, tables fill, counts repeat on a second run, and no forecast uses evidence answered or extracted after its ask; the real-data half runs in the main checkout with --require-local-data and its summary line is on the row

steps.name: Rick reads the principles and prunes dimensions
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: HUMAN Rick's design call. whether an extracted principle truly states his preference is his judgment, there is no oracle; Rick reads the list and prunes the dimension vocabulary (open sub-question 1)

steps.name: Layers 0 and 1: closing gate
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. steps.name: Size the corpus and set gate numbers

steps.name: Rick accepts the gate numbers
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: HUMAN Rick's design call. the thresholds are judgments (layer 2 starts at 20 fields from 5 sessions, layer 3 at 20 open-text targets)

steps.name: Write arm forecasts in the ask-time commit
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. The displayed arm's sibling row is written in the same commit as its prediction_log row; a sibling failure rolls both back and returns False; the reconciliation check (every prediction_log row has its displayed-arm sibling) catches a planted missing row; waits on open sub-question 6's ruling

steps.name: Make B1's second call per ask

steps.name: Store the draft answer at reveal

steps.name: Produce the per-arm summary

steps.name: Build comparisons and the labelling pass
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. One comparison per answered field (chosen against the mean of the unchosen); one cached labelling call per field through harness_runner.cached; a write-in is labelled through the extractor's dimensions

steps.name: Rank, abstain and rebuild by replay
steps.acceptance: EXECUTOR: AI. Margin is abs(w .
